observation.command: pkill -f "GradleDaemon" 2>/dev/null; /opt/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb emu kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 3; cat /workspace/android/gradle.properties; sed -i 's/org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx8G -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=4G/org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx3G -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=1G/' /workspace/android/gradle.properties && cat /workspace/android/gradle.properties && free -h | head -2
